Court No. - 78
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 19469 of 2024

Applicant :- Sarvesh Agarwal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Suraj Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the learned Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track Court, Court No. 13, Varanasi to decide the trial of Special Session Trial No. 1295 of 2021, titled State v. Sarvesh Agarwal and another, arising out of Case Crime No. 218 of 2021, under Sections 269, 270, 420 IPC and Section 4 Epidemic Diseases and Section 18(a)(i), Section 27 Drugs and Cosmetics Act, P.S. Sigra, District Varanasi, pending in the Court of Additional sessions Judge/Fast Track Court, Court No. 13,
Varanasi, within stipulated time.

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the trial of the case is pending since 2021 but no progress has been made so far.
Learned counsel further submits that a direction may be issued to the concerned Court to decide the same within some specific time frame.
